review_scope: evidence-binding measurement of the F1 falsifier suite against the live F1 rev13 bytes; not a full-schema accept/revise of the F1 schema itself

hard_failures.label: all 25 suite rows bind the superseded F1 rev12 hash cce9c60146d6 while the canonical F1 schema is rev13 d9cebb9404b2; the suite's own vendor verifier hard check C1a (verify_freeze_current.py:171-176) is therefore false

findings.statement: Two stored probes in row F1-AMB-25 still re-evaluate false against the live rev13 bytes: f0_binding.declared_f0_sha256 expects the superseded F0 rev4 hash 276009f4f63d (live F0 is 0abb9ed8a961) and f0_binding.binding_note expects the string 'astra-classscope-02'. The same two mismatches recompute at the rev12 snapshot, so the rev13 re-pin did not introduce them; it also did not repair them. Independent replication of artifacts/worker-032/f1amb25/report.json at the new pin.

The single declared cross_artifact binding in the suite (F1-AMB-25, research_map/formulation_taxonomy.yaml) still stores F0 rev4 276009f4f63d; live F0 is 0abb9ed8a961. The suite's own cross-artifact check (vendor C9) fails on these bytes.

The stale binding is not merely cosmetic: rev12->rev13 changed 12 leaf paths, including probed path f0_binding.binding_note and probed deciding field visibility.definition. A rebind-only edit (binding_sha256/rebound_at) would leave the two false probes and the stale cross-artifact declaration in place; the suite needs both a rebind to d9cebb9404b2 and a content repair of F1-AMB-25's f0_binding expectations.

FROZEN was re-emitted under the same revision label 29 at 00:57:26 with a new hash (3d9e3d77fd87 -> 815e08079aef); F1, suite and mirror entries are byte-identical across both emissions. The measurement binds to 815e08079aef; downstream reviews citing 'rev29' alone cannot distinguish them.

Instrument note: the vendor verifier was not executed because it rewrites artifacts/flash-04/f1_ambiguity/frozen_current_verification.json; its C1a/C1b/C8/C9 semantics were reimplemented independently. Controls: binding-responsive mutation, probe-sensitivity mutation, idempotent census, malformed-path no-crash, unknown-kind fail-closed (5/5); T0==T1 zero drift.

Contamination note: this review was written after the reviewer had read map-level claim summaries that mention some F1/F2 verdicts; no reviews/F1-review-* file was read for this verdict, and the verdict is derived only from the pinned artifact bytes. counts_as_full_schema_verdict=false: this does not satisfy the G-FORM requirement of two independent full-schema accepts per class.

falsifier: A suite row rebound to the live F1 rev13 sha256 d9cebb9404b2, or a FROZEN/F1 re-pin away from the hashes above, or a rev13 probe recomputation with an empty mismatch set while the binding stays stale. A demonstration that the two AMB-25 f0_binding probes are intentionally historical (not asserted) would downgrade HF-W029-F1-01 to a documentation defect but would not make C1a true.
next_falsifier: Re-run artifacts/worker-029/f1_suite_rebind/check_f1_suite_rebind.py after the suite owner performs the declared rebind and repairs F1-AMB-25: expect 25/25 rows bound to the current canonical F1 pin, vendor C1a true, and 0 recomputed mismatches at the new pin.
authority_note: Worker evidence only. No gate verdict, no node status, no validation_status=passed, no canonical byte written. Only the audit lead / controller may convert this into a G-FORM decision.
